dependencies.name: schemars
dependencies.reason: Z1-T4: derives the configuration file's JSON Schema (config.schema.json) and reference page from the typed sections in attome-config.
dependencies.maintenance: Active; 1.x stable line, widely used (utoipa and axum ecosystems).

dependencies.name: schemars_derive
dependencies.reason: Z1-T4: the derive macro of schemars.

dependencies.name: serde_derive_internals
dependencies.reason: Z1-T4: used by schemars_derive to read serde attributes, so the schema follows serde's renames and defaults.

dependencies.name: dyn-clone
dependencies.reason: Z1-T4: a schemars dependency (cloneable schema transforms).
dependencies.maintenance: Maintained by dtolnay; small and stable.

dependencies.name: ref-cast
dependencies.reason: Z1-T4: a schemars dependency (safe reference casts for its Schema type).
dependencies.maintenance: Maintained by dtolnay; small and stable.

dependencies.name: ref-cast-impl
dependencies.reason: Z1-T4: the derive macro of ref-cast.

dependencies.name: async-imap
dependencies.reason: J2-T1: reads IMAP mailboxes (login, select, UID fetch) over the rustls connection, so shared and personal mailboxes sync into Attome.
dependencies.maintenance: Maintained by the chatmail (Delta Chat) project; used in production by Delta Chat.

dependencies.name: mail-parser
dependencies.reason: J2-T1: parses IMAP messages (MIME parts, encoded words, charsets including Arabic code pages) in pure Rust, with no unsafe code.
dependencies.maintenance: Maintained by Stalwart Labs; the parser of the Stalwart mail server.

dependencies.name: zxing-wasm
dependencies.reason: B16-T1: decodes barcodes and QR codes from camera frames in browsers without BarcodeDetector (@attome/base/scan), loaded with a dynamic import so it is never in the main bundle.
dependencies.maintenance: Active; monthly releases (3.1.x in 2026), WebAssembly build of zxing-cpp.

dependencies.name: type-fest
dependencies.reason: B16-T1: a type-only dependency of zxing-wasm (its own nested copy).

dependencies.name: tagged-tag
dependencies.reason: B16-T1: a dependency of type-fest, pulled in by zxing-wasm.

dependencies.name: @types/emscripten
dependencies.reason: B16-T1: type declarations zxing-wasm depends on for its Emscripten module.

dependencies.name: bwip-js
dependencies.reason: B16-T11: draws QR codes, Code 128, EAN-13 and Data Matrix as SVG in the browser (Show code), loaded on first use into a lazy chunk.
dependencies.maintenance: Active; regular releases, port of Barcode Writer in Pure PostScript.

dependencies.name: image
dependencies.reason: Z6-T6: decodes clean PNG, JPEG and WebP uploads and resizes them into the 256-pixel thumbnails the file panel shows; default features off, three decoders only.

dependencies.name: multer
dependencies.reason: A23-T8: axum's multipart feature (the import upload route reads a file and its options as multipart/form-data); pure Rust, the parser axum's own Multipart extractor uses.
dependencies.maintenance: Maintained alongside axum's extractors; stable 3.x line.
